title: 耶鲁Joyce：黄仁勋60名直接下属，英伟达治理为何如此集中？
speaker: Joyce

segments.en: Let's talk a bit more about corporate governance You mentioned this was a board that maybe had the capacity to manage a company when it was much smaller now of course It's one of the largest in the world. There's a great headline in the financial times the Nvidia boards artificial independence
segments.zh: 我们再聊聊公司治理。你提到这个董事会或许有能力管理一家规模小得多的公司，而现在它已是全球最大公司之一。金融时报有个很棒的标题：英伟达董事会的虚假独立性。

segments.en: I'll read a line from it with all the quarterly review meetings expense sign-offs and year-end appraisals The surely come with 60 direct reports Jensen Huang got 60 direct reports. It's amazing Jensen Huang had time for extramarital affairs
segments.zh: 我读一句：所有季度审查会议、费用签批和年终评估，肯定都来自60个直接下属。黄仁勋有60个直接汇报。太惊人了，黄仁勋还有时间搞婚外情。

segments.en: How did the governance of this company continue in the form it's been in For as long as it was I mean I've heard somebody say effectively he was the chairman of the company
segments.zh: 这家公司的治理如何以原有形式持续了那么久？我听过有人说，他实际上就是公司董事长。

segments.en: They didn't have an official one until recent weeks here Why was it such a problem there that it was so calcified and I guess stepping back Why does it seem like this is a problem with a lot of the Silicon Valley companies?
segments.zh: 直到最近几周他们才有正式的董事长。为什么那里问题如此严重、如此僵化？退一步看，为什么这似乎是许多硅谷公司的问题？
